name: Leatherworking
desc: Higher leatherworking skill allows you to learn higher level leatherworking patterns.  Leatherworking patterns can be found on trainers around the world as well as from quests and monsters.

ranks.name: Apprentice
ranks.desc: Allows a leatherworker to make leather armor, up to a maximum potential skill of 75. Requires leather scraps and hides gathered with the Skinning skill.

ranks.name: Journeyman
ranks.desc: Allows a leatherworker to make well crafted leather armors, up to a maximum potential skill of 150.

ranks.name: Expert
ranks.desc: Allows a leatherworker to make high quality leather armors, up to a maximum potential skill of 225.

ranks.name: Artisan
ranks.desc: Allows a leatherworker to make artisan quality leather armors, up to a maximum potential skill of 300.

specs.name: Dragonscale Leatherworking
specs.desc: Allows a leatherworker to make special dragonscale armors that are unavailable to a normal leatherworker. Dragonscale armor is all mail armor.

specs.name: Tribal Leatherworking
specs.desc: Allows a leatherworker to make special tribal armors that are unavailable to a normal leatherworker.

specs.name: Elemental Leatherworking
specs.desc: Allows a leatherworker to make special elemental armors that are unavailable to a normal leatherworker.
